title: Ridgeline Tool Rental and Accounts Held Elsewhere at Ridgeline
content:
What a renter holds elsewhere at Ridgeline changes the deposit and the rate on a Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement.

## Security deposit and the Ridgeline Pro Credit account

In an equipment class whose deposit waiver for Pro Credit is shown as available on the deposit table, no security deposit is collected when the rental charges are to be paid with a Ridgeline Pro Credit account of the renter whose status is active. An account on hold, closed or charged off does not waive the deposit.

| Rental charges paid with | Account status | Class allows the waiver | Security deposit |
|---|---|---|---|
| the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account | active | yes | not collected |
| the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account | on hold | yes | collected |
| the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account | closed | yes | collected |
| the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account | charged off | yes | collected |
| the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account | active | no | collected |

The status that counts is the status the Pro Credit account record shows; the account must be the renter's own and must be the tender for the rental charges.

## ProBuild membership and the rental rate

> Former clause: the ProBuild Rewards rental discount applied only when the renter's ProBuild membership was active on the checkout date, at the discount percentage of the ProBuild tier held on that date. This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the ProBuild discount rate of a rental agreement.

## Hypothetical example

A remodeler takes out a Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry mixer and charges the rental to a Ridgeline Pro Credit account that the account record shows on hold. The account is not active, so the security deposit of the class is collected at checkout.

superseded_clauses: The ProBuild Rewards rental discount applies only when the renter's ProBuild membership is active on the checkout date, at the discount percentage of the ProBuild tier held on that date (Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards parameter rental_discount_pct).
